final: WITH mj AS (SELECT m.zoneref AS zone, s.entrystat AS status, m.facetfaces AS faces FROM scanmesh m JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref), g AS (SELECT zone, status, AVG(faces) AS gavg FROM mj WHERE faces IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zone, status), ov AS (SELECT AVG(gavg) AS oavg FROM g), p AS (SELECT g.zone, g.status, g.gavg, ov.oavg, g.gavg - ov.oavg AS d FROM g CROSS JOIN ov WHERE ov.oavg IS NOT NULL), sg AS (SELECT status, AVG(gavg) AS savg FROM p GROUP BY status), k AS (SELECT p.gavg, p.d, p.status, sg.savg FROM p JOIN sg ON sg.status = p.status WHERE p.gavg > sg.savg) SELECT AVG(gavg) AS avg_group_avg, AVG(d) AS avg_diff_overall, AVG(gavg - savg) AS avg_diff_status FROM k
